profile_text.body:
Uber Technologies, Inc operates the Uber platform and apps, which its website describes as tools to earn more, eat, commute, get a ride, simplify business travel, and more. The company says it is introducing autonomous vehicles on Uber, describing autonomous vehicles as a key part of the future and a safety-driven approach that combines autonomous vehicles and drivers, in partnership with industry leaders.

No specific AI products are listed in the available facts. The company's website text focuses on the platform and autonomous vehicles rather than named AI product lines.

The company is a for-profit public company headquartered in San Francisco, CA, trading under the ticker UBER, with CIK 0001543151. The company is associated with 281 California law exposure entries and no cases.
